summary: Billing back office: clerks look up customers, orders and stock in desktop programs, invoices are created through an API, closed when overdue, exported to the ledger every night and e-mailed to customers.

screens.purpose: Find a customer by name, city or status and see their address.
user_actions: Type a name or city and press Search
Double-click a customer to see the address
screens.next_steps: The address opens in a message box.

screens.purpose: Search orders of a customer by status and date.
user_actions: Double-click an order to open its detail

screens.purpose: Look up stock items and adjust quantities.
Search contacts by region and name.

batches.purpose: Marks unpaid invoices past their due date as overdue.

programs.name: InvoiceJobs.CloseOverdue
programs.what_it_does: Sets overdue status on open invoices past their due date

batches.purpose: Sends the day's invoices to the ledger team as a CSV file.
E-mails each new invoice to the customer.
batches.when: Runs all the time as a Windows service; no schedule

web_services.purpose: Reads one invoice and creates new invoices.
